chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
"The qunūt is in every two rakʿahs in both voluntary and obligatory prayers."

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abī Jaʿfar; Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الْقُنُوتُ: qunūt; the supplication recited in the standing position of prayer
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: two rakʿahs; a pair of prayer units

ai.seo_question: In which prayers and how often is qunūt performed according to Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling that qunūt is prescribed in every two rakʿahs, whether in supererogatory prayers or in obligatory prayers. It indicates the regular place of qunūt within the structure of salat and reflects its established role in acts of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.934 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that He said:
"The Qunoot (supplication) is in every two units of both voluntary and obligatory prayers."
